name: Clementine
description: Clementine's recovered macOS bundle metadata configures the Sparkle feed at https://clementine-data.appspot.com/sparkle and names sparkle_pub.pem as SUPublicDSAKeyFile. The snapshot does not establish Sparkle runtime enforcement, historical release behavior, or the Windows update-check implementation.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; Sparkle framework call sites, released macOS artifacts, key-size interpretation, and Windows update behavior were not established.
